visualCharacteristics: Slick carousel with a light-blue illustrated background image (province map) per slide; circular winner portrait at left, winner name (H3, white) and location, 'See all winners' arrow button, game logo with red 'Winner' ribbon and white boxed prize-amount digits at right; thin outlined chevron arrows and small dots.
contentPattern: Interactive slider of winner slides (arrows, dots) with an image per slide plus name, location, CTA and prize amount; prize amount and location stay paragraphs, not headings. Winner spotlight slides: circular portrait, name/location, CTA, game logo ribbon and boxed prize digits over an illustrated background; no existing variant
usage: Recent winners spotlight slider on the home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for winner/testimonial spotlight slides over an illustrated background. One row per slide: cell 1 = background image; cell 2 = portrait image, heading (winner name), location paragraph, CTA link, game logo image, ribbon label paragraph (e.g. Winner), prize amount paragraph (e.g. $500 000). The second image in cell 2 starts the prize group.

cells: Image (mandatory): slide background/banner image; for image-only slides, link the image to the promo URL
Text (optional): title as heading, description/additional paragraphs, CTA link

usage: Each slide: cell1 = background illustration image; cell2 = portrait image, H3 winner name, location paragraph, CTA 'See all winners', game logo image, 'Winner' paragraph, prize amount paragraph (e.g. '$500 000').
blockContent.description: 4 winner slides: background image, portrait, winner name, city/province, 'See all winners' CTA, game logo + 'Winner' ribbon, prize amount (e.g. $500 000, $1 000 000, $2 000 000)
